CONSUMER SCAN (new-prohibition: route rebar TRACKER ops through the MCP server; carve-out = local-code ops). Enumerated every guidance/workflow instruction that runs 'rebar <verb>' for a tracker op and its reconciliation disposition:

RECONCILED HERE (this ticket, AGENTS.md):
- AGENTS.md 'Record your work' + 'parallel-agent workflow' (claim/transition/create/comment/link/reopen/search/list/show/ready/next-batch) and the review-plan/verify-completion gate ops -> covered by the new umbrella section 'Drive the tracker through the MCP server (local-code ops are the carve-out)'. It defines a 'rebar <verb>' for a tracker op as the operation to invoke through MCP when configured, and names the downstream surfaces it governs.
- AGENTS.md rebar review-plan <id> --status (read-only currency check), rebar review-code preview, rebar verify-commit-ticket, rebar explain, running tests/git -> explicit LOCAL-CODE CARVE-OUT (stay local).
- AGENTS.md rebar transition ... closed --ref <sha> (close) -> umbrella-covered tracker write.

UMBRELLA-COVERED BY REFERENCE + queued for a per-file textual sweep (follow-up ticket abeyant-upstanding-limpet cc73-e1c8, linked discovered_from):
- .agents/rules/rebar.md:21-24 (claim/transition/link/review-plan)
- templates/AGENTS.md:46,48,50,81 and templates/rebar-usage.md:22,24,26,57 (claim/link/transition/review-plan)
- src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md:15,20,106,304 and passing-code-review.md:127-128,143,157 (review-plan)
- examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md:167,198,358; rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md:140,144; rebar-debug/SKILL.md:588,668,884 (claim/transition/review-plan)

REFERENCE DOCS (describe ops, not agent 'run-locally' mandates; umbrella-covered): docs/concurrency.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md, docs/user-guide.md, docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md.

OUTCOME: no surviving instruction contradicts the new rule. Every tracker-op mention is either (a) the operation-name-via-MCP semantics set by the AGENTS.md umbrella, (b) an explicit local-code carve-out, or (c) queued for the mechanical per-file follow-up (cc73-e1c8) while already semantically reconciled. Scope of this docs leaf stays AGENTS.md + docs per the ticket.
